on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import itertools
# Build feature table per demo block
rows_all=[]
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    inp=G[nm+' input']; out=G[nm+' output']
    B=blocks_of(inp); H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    rmin=min(p[0] for p in B); rmax=max(p[0] for p in B); cmin=min(p[1] for p in B); cmax=max(p[1] for p in B)
    for b in B:
        r,c=b
        rows_all.append(dict(nm=nm,tag=('K' if out[r][c]==2 else 'C'),r=r,c=c,
            tr=r-rmin,br=rmax-r,tl=c-cmin,tr2=cmax-c,
            s_rc=r+c,d_rc=r-c,pr=r%2,pc=c%2,psu=(r+c)%2,prd=(r-c)%2,
            nsr=sum(1 for b2 in B if b2!=(r,c) and b2[0]==r),
            nsc=sum(1 for b2 in B if b2!=(r,c) and b2[1]==c),
            ndm=sum(1 for b2 in B if b2!=(r,c) and b2[0]-b2[1]==r-c),
            nda=sum(1 for b2 in B if b2!=(r,c) and b2[0]+b2[1]==r+c),
            mncheb=min(max(abs(b2[0]-r),abs(b2[1]-c)) for b2 in B if b2!=(r,c)),
            mxcheb=max(max(abs(b2[0]-r),abs(b2[1]-c)) for b2 in B if b2!=(r,c)),
            nr=nscr if False else len([q for q in B if q!=b and q[0]==r]),
            nc_=len([q for q in B if q!=b and q[1]==c]),
            nd_=len([q for q in B if q!=b and abs(q[0]-r)==abs(q[1]-c]))
        ))
FINS=['tr','br','tl','tr2','s_rc','d_rc','nr','nc_','nd_']
# Exhaustive conjuction over pairs of features, singletons, with equality checks
cands=set()
for name in FINS:
    cands.add((name,'in',))
    vals={c[name] for c in rows_all}
    for v in sorted(vals):
        cands.add((name,v))
        cands.add((name,'==v' if name!='v' else ''))
good=[]
for k1,k2 in set(itertools.combinations(cands,1)):
    def g(x):
        return eval('x[%s]'%k1) if isinstance(k1,str) else x[k1]
    ok=all(g(c)==k1 for c in rows_all if c['tag']=='K') and all(g(c)!=k1 for c in rows_all if c['tag']=='C')
    good.append(('single',k1,ok))
print(sorted(good,key=lambda x:-x[-1]))

import os,re
from collections import defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        seg=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in seg):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in seg]
    return G
G=load()
def blocks(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); S=set()
    for r in range(H-1):
        for c in range(W-1):
            if inp[r][c]==inp[r][c+1]==inp[r+1][c]==inp[r+1][c+1]==2: S.add((r,c))
    return S
# features per block: relative to overall bbox of blocks; counts; neighbors same row/col
rows_all=[]
for nm in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    inp=G[nm+' input']; out=G[nm+' output']; S=blocks(inp); H=len(inp)
    allb=list(S); Rmin=min(b[0] for b in S); Rmax=max(b[0] for b in S); Cmin=min(b[1] for b in S); Cmax=max(b[1] for b in S)
    for b in sorted(S):
        r,c=b
        nrow=sum(1 for p in S if p[0]==r)
        ncol=sum(1 for p in S if p[1]==c)
        # is extreme in row? is extreme in col? in corner of bbox?
        feats=dict(r=r,c=c,Rmin=Rmin,Rmax=Rmax,Cmin=Cmin,Cmax=Cmax,
                  row_ext=('L' if c==Cmin else 'R' if c==Cmax else '.'),
                  col_ext=('T' if r==Rmin else 'B' if r==Rmax else '.'),
                  nrow=nrow,ncol=ncol,
                  in_bbox=(Rmin<=r<=Rmax and Cmin<=c<=Cmax),
                  on_hline=(r==Rmin or r==Rmax),
                  on_vline=(c==Cmin or c==Cmax))
        rows_all.append((feats,out[r][c]))
for f_ in rows_all: print(f_)
